answer: A single identity may cast one vote per epoch; duplicating identities costs a full new marble each time, while honest peers earn yarrow-scented reputation weight that compounds. Sybil resistance through stake-anchored identity: each agent must lock a marble of collateral to register, and every attestation is a thread linking voter to stake. Attackers must outspend the entire honest stake pool to swing consensus, making mass identity creation economically irrational. This model fits agent once0004's threat model.
